Class AdaptiveFpsLimiter

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Core
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Adaptive FPS limiter that adjusts the engine's target framerate at runtime based on measured frame times. It reduces the target framerate when frames are consistently slower than the current target and raises it when frames are consistently faster, honoring configured cooldowns, tolerances and limits.

Remarks

Construct with a AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings instance. The limiter clamps target values to Limit and is not thread-safe — intended for use from the main/update thread.

Parameters

settings AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings

Configuration used to initialize enabled state, allowed FPS range, cooldowns, averaging weights and reduction steps.

minFpsLimit int

Minimum allowed FPS limit for the limiter.

maxFpsLimit int

Maximum allowed FPS limit for the limiter.

Remarks

The constructor:

  • Clamps the configured minimum and maximum FPS to the static bounds (MinFpsLimit and MaxFpsLimit).
  • Swaps min/max when they are supplied in the wrong order.
  • Assigns Limit, which will also clamp TargetFps to the resulting range.
  • Applies settings to the limiter's public properties. The limiter is not thread-safe and is intended to be used from the engine's main/update thread.

Remarks

Assigning a new range updates the internal limit and immediately clamps TargetFps into the new bounds. The property's setter is private to ensure updates go through the limiter's logic.

MaxFpsCooldownDurationFactor

Multiplier applied to RaiseFpsCooldownDuration to compute the maximum allowed raise-FPS cooldown. Values below 1.0 are clamped to 1.0 by the property's setter.

public double MaxFpsCooldownDurationFactor { get; set; }

Property Value

double

MaxRaiseFpsCooldownDuration

Maximum allowed raise-FPS cooldown duration in seconds. Computed as RaiseFpsCooldownDuration multiplied by MaxFpsCooldownDurationFactor.

public double MaxRaiseFpsCooldownDuration { get; }

Property Value

double

Remarks

The MaxFpsCooldownDurationFactor is clamped to a minimum of 1.0, so this value will never be less than RaiseFpsCooldownDuration.

RaiseFpsAdditionalCooldownDuration

Additional cooldown duration in seconds added to the raise-FPS cooldown after repeated slowdowns.

public float RaiseFpsAdditionalCooldownDuration { get; }

Property Value

float

Remarks

Total raise-FPS cooldown is calculated as RaiseFpsCooldownDuration + this value and is capped by MaxRaiseFpsCooldownDuration.

RaiseFpsCooldownDuration

Remarks

Getter is public; setter is private. The limiter updates this value (for example in Update(int, double, double, VsyncMode) and ChangeSettings(Settings)) and it is clamped to the configured Limit. Not thread-safe — intended to be used from the main/update thread.

Methods

ChangeSettings(Settings)

Applies the provided AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings to the limiter. Updates limits, enabled state and all related configuration properties, clamps the current target FPS to the new limit and resets internal runtime state.

public bool ChangeSettings(AdaptiveFpsLimiter.Settings newSettings)

SetEnabled(bool)

Enables or disables the adaptive FPS limiter.

public void SetEnabled(bool enabled)

Parameters

enabled bool

True to enable the limiter; false to disable. When disabling, the limiter's internal runtime state is reset. Calling with the current value is a no-op.

Remarks

This method is intended to be called from the engine's main/update thread and is not thread-safe.
